title: Franc's Hand
summary: A quest item found in Dolor’s Hand Bag for Impress the Murder Tribunal.

fields.Quest use: Dolor’s bag of hands can be presented as proof to the Tribunal entrance guardian. Franc’s Hand is one of the bag’s contents.
fields.Acquisition: Obtain the Hand Bag by defeating or pickpocketing Dolor.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
